reasoning: The design system foundation shows moderate maturity with 28/50 points. Strong areas include status color system (4/4), single font family (3/3), spacing consistency (4/4), reusable card components (4/4), and badge components (3/3). The color palette is partially defined (4/6) with gradients and dark theme colors but lacks comprehensive light theme palette. Critical gaps include no typography scale definition (0/5) and no systematic button variant system (2/4 partial credit for existing patterns). Form elements are styled consistently (2/2). The foundation provides good consistency for Day 6 baseline but lacks formal design system documentation and some systematic component variants.
